size_control.reproduction_python:
import json,time,tracemalloc
from storymodel import make_account
from storymodel.model import Document,Unit,Support,Span
from storymodel.organization import OrganizationDestination,DestinationMass,OrganizationRow,OrganizationOrder,OrganizationJoint,JointMass,OrganizationSpec,organization_readout

def account(side,n):
 d=Document.create('organization-scale-'+side,side,'A'*n)
 units=tuple(Unit(kind='row' if side=='source' else 'recall',support=Support(document=d.id,spans=(Span(start=i,end=i+1),))) for i in range(n))
 return make_account((d,),units=units),units
out=[]
source,anchors=account('source',200);recall,units=account('recall',50)
order=OrganizationOrder(positions={u.id:float(i) for i,u in enumerate(anchors)})
for k in (8,32):
 destinations=[tuple(OrganizationDestination(target=anchors[(3*i+j)%len(anchors)].id) for j in range(k)) for i in range(len(units))]
 rows=tuple(OrganizationRow(unit=u.id,mass=tuple(DestinationMass(destination=d,weight=1/k) for d in ds)) for u,ds in zip(units,destinations))
 joints=tuple(OrganizationJoint(left_unit=a.unit,right_unit=b.unit,mass=tuple(JointMass(left=x,right=y,weight=1/k) for x,y in zip(destinations[i],destinations[i+1]))) for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(rows,rows[1:])))
 spec=OrganizationSpec(rows=rows,order=order,dependence='adjacent-joints',joints=joints,product_bounds=False)
 tracemalloc.start();start=time.perf_counter();result=organization_readout(source,recall,spec)
 seconds=time.perf_counter()-start;_,peak=tracemalloc.get_traced_memory();tracemalloc.stop()
 assert result.adjacency_count==49 and result.counts['forward']==49
 out.append(dict(source_targets=200,recall_rows=50,destinations_per_row=k,joint_edges=49*k,seconds=seconds,peak_python_bytes=peak))
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
